name: Necopoli ~Neko no Omawari-san~
original_name: ねこぽり ～ねこのおまわりさん～
source:
An adventure game where you protect the town via a cute cat-eared police woman. In addition to the outrageous and dirty elements, the undercover maid cafe operation adds the perfect element of moe.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ036390.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一款冒险游戏，你可以通过可爱的猫耳女警来保护城镇。除了出格、肮脏的元素之外，卧底女仆咖啡厅的运作又增添了完美的萌元素。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ036390.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
